# AWS Region availability for AWS Control Tower controls

This section contains tables that show the AWS Region availability for controls. Older controls have a unique API identifier for each Region in which AWS Control Tower is available. Each control also has a [global identifier](all-global-identifiers.md "all-global-identifiers.md"). When you are working with the control APIs, you can provide the identifier for the Region in which you are making the API call, or the global identifier. We recommend that you provide the global identifier in most cases.

###### Note

If the table shows **N/A** in the **ARN** field, the control does not have a regional identifier, only a global identifier. To view global identifiers, see [All global identifiers for AWS Control Tower controls](all-global-identifiers.md "all-global-identifiers.md").

Last updated May 6, 2025.
